Alcohol companies challenge FSSAI flavoring notices in courts

Two alcohol companies, United Spirits and Associated Alcohol, have filed challenges in High Courts against notices issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI). The notices pertain to flavoring norms for alcoholic beverages. The companies are seeking to overturn these directives through legal proceedings.
